notes.title: Up to 80% off in the Lunar New Year Sales!
notes.content:
Hello Playism Fans

Happy Lunar New Year! The Steam sales have kicked off and there are celebrations all around. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/5b34f11649768631e2636eedbee21fa557796632.jpg[/img]

We have set a whole bunch of amazing Playism games on sale, with up to 80% off! 
Check out the full list on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Playism/list/36822]our Publisher Page[/url] or [url=http://blog.playism-games.com/steam-lunar-new-year-sale-2019/]on the Playism blog[/url]. 

On top of having up to 80% off, we also have some exciting news! 

[h1]Touhou Luna Nights - Announcing the next update and end of Early Access[/h1]
At the end of February, we will be updating Touhou Luna Nights with Stage 4 & 5, as well as ending Early Access.
Once we have left Early Access, the game will be increasing in price to $17.99! If you are wondering whether to grab the game, we recommend grabbing it now during the Luna New Year Sale! 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/playism#announcements/detail/1732100228743235285]For more information and news, check out our update here.[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/


[h1]Recent Updates / Games[/h1]
[b]Misao: Definitive Edition / Mad Father[/b]
Misao: Definitive Edition and Mad Father recently got updated to improve gameplay. Check out these classic horror games now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/691450/Misao_Definitive_Edition/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/483980/Mad_Father/

[b]Strange Telephone[/b]
Our recent indie hit, Strange Telephone, is out now on Steam! Fans of Yume Nikki and YumeNikki ~DREAM DIARY~ are bound to love this title too. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/705290/Strange_Telephone/

notes.title: Star Sky Joins the Holiday Sales!
notes.content:
The holiday sales have kicked off on Steam, and we have added Star Sky to the festive activities! 

[quote]Star Sky is a game about a man taking a midnight stroll. You take the same road as many times as you want, each time hopefully unlocking new encounters. Can you unlock the mysteries of the night?
[/quote]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407020/Star_Sky/

notes.title: Star Sky on Sale and New Bundle Info!
notes.content:
Hi All!

We hope you are having fantastic holidays! 

The Steam Winter Sales have started, and Star Sky has joined the sales, you can now get it for 75% off! 

You can find all the Playism titles that are on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?snr=1_4_4__12&term=agm+playism]sale here[/url], or [url=http://playism-games.com/article/steam-winter-sales-2016-2017]listed on our blog![/url]

[h1]We have also just added some exciting bundles![/h1] 
Star Sky and Meadowland are now part of the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2356/]Dream Collection[/url] bundle!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2356/] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7036217/2b811222598aad3221d42529c79c8640cbfa63b4.jpg[/img]
[/url] 

[quote]In a world filled with stories of dreams, magic and places far away, the Dream Collection will introduce these fleeting worlds to you, and let you indulge in them as much as you want. Can you find the secrets they all contain? [/quote]

[h1]The bundle includes: [/h1]
Star Sky
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407020/
Meadowland
http://store.steampowered.com/app/320120/

[h1]For a full list of our new bundles, make sure you check out our blog post:[/h1]
[url=http://playism-games.com/article/playisms-new-bundles]Playism's New Bundles! on the Playism Blog[/url]

[h1]For more information and news, be sure to join the Playism Group! [/h1]
We regularly post news, updates, game recommendations and more! 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/playism]Playism Selection Group[/url]
